The '''''Silver Bolt''''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] operated by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] member [[Erisson Flask]]. [[Polke]] acted as the co-[[Pilot/Legends|pilot]]. At some point, it was engaged in battle by [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]].
